name: design-system
description: Shared design system for TheBibleProject, ChurchHQ and TuitionManager: one token source, per-app themes, web + React Native + SwiftUI + Compose + Flutter

scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/tokens typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/ui-web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/ui-native typecheck
scripts.verify: bun run tokens:check && bun run test && bun run typecheck
scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/tokens build && bun run --cwd packages/ui-web build && bun run --cwd packages/ui-native build
